Frequently Asked Questions

What are the major Telugu festivals in 2026?

Major Telugu festivals in 2026 include: Ugadi, Sri Rama Navami, Vinayaka Chavithi, Dasara, Deepavali, Karthika Pournami. All festivals are shown according to New Jersey Eastern Time.

How to use Telugu Panchangam in USA?

We provide accurate Telugu Panchangam for USA (New Jersey, Eastern Time). You can view daily tithi, nakshatra, festivals, and durmuhurtham timings for each day.

What timezone are the Telugu Panchangam timings in?

All timings are displayed in Eastern Time (ET / America/New_York). This applies to states like New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, and Florida.
